text: Krásny hotel, vynikajúce raňajky, skvelý wellness, vírivka, sauny. Mali sme super izbu, priestrannú, všetko čisté. Plus veľmi milý personál. Boli sme maximálne spokojní.

text: Výborne služby,čisté izby, milí personál, výborné jedlo.🙂 👍

text: Super Service, sehr sauber, sehr gutes Essen.

name: trystb2018
text: Booked last minute at the Golden Keys on business for 4 nights. Not my usual Nitra hotel of choice mainly due to the fact it was up the Zobor hill away from the city and not an easy walk back from the shops and restaurants if you just wanted to pop out. Taxis definitely required.|The hotels price is more expensive than all the inner city hotel rates probably due to its opulent decor, expensive a la carte restaurant, spa and stunning views. I think the best thing about the hotel is however, the front of house staff who were very polite, courteous and attentive.|I arrived mid evening after a long flight and decided to have a short nap in my comfortable bed. Once awake, I went to get myself ready to meet colleagues in Nitra. When I flushed the toilet, the water was yellow. OK, I thought - must be an issue. Went to wash my hands and low and behold - yellow water.!! There was definitely an issue. I thought best not to use the shower (pornographic terms spring to mind) !! Went to reception and, to be fair, they were very apologetic and gave me another room. So I repacked and moved to the other room, the other side of the annexe.|As it was now too late to go eat with colleagues, my only option was to eat in the empty expensive restaurant. The food was big on price and flavour but small on quantity, so the stale pringles and chocolate peanuts in the room had to become an added expensive dessert!|At least I had a hearty breakfast to look forward to,, which had the potential as the varied choice lifted my spirits. Unfortunately, the bad experience continued as the hot section was lukewarm at best with only one choice of egg which was limp and fried with no fresh fruit and yoghurt which was a long way from the a la carte dining experienced the night before.. At least the coffee and juice was nice and refreshing.|The rest of the week went without too much drama apart from the habitual 15 wait for a taxi to work because of the location and winding gulleys up and down the hill, which you had to plan into your day around.|Came to my last evening before my early flight in the morning. I had decided to not go into town because of the impending rain so it would the hotel restaurant and early to bed. When I came back from work, I noticed there were two events on with a wedding on the big hall by my room. I thought it should be OK as it shouldn’t be too loud as you couldn’t hear the incessant new age jazz played in the corridors and shouldn’t go beyond 12. How wrong I was. The disco was deafening sounding like I had a funfair under the floorboards playing till 4am in the morning. I now know how the inmates feel at Guantanemo bay. |At least I could break up the infuriating night in with a nice but small a la catre meal. Unfortunately when I went to eat, i discovered, due to the events, the restaurant was closed all evening. As there was no signage to state this closure and too late to get ready and taxi it to town, it was a fast food delivery and eat my burger meal listing to Polka music from the wedding in my room!|On reflection, I should have gate crashed the wedding in my flip flops shorts and football top posing as a long lost English cousin and not sat in my room writing this hotel review listening to Slovak folk songs and latin boom boom music. Thank god for air pods and Netflix on my phone. I could always sleep on the plane.|On the surface, the hotel has a lot to offer but all of these disappointing turn of events could have been avoided with better maintenance, room scheduling, and stricter noise restrictions and shut off timings on events near non attending guests who have paid a lot of money for a decent night’s sleep.| I will be looking to book business trips to Nitra further in advance in future to secure the hotel I want which will be in the city centre and not the Golden Keys|SHAME

name: Katarína
text: Pekné ubytovanie,milý personál,celková spokojnosť

name: Alexandra
text: die Lage vom Hotel Golden Key ist wnderschön auf einem Hügel gelegen mit Blick auf das Schloss von Nitra, das Personal ist sehr freundlich und hilfsbereich, die Zimmer sind groß, schön eingerichtet und bequem. Alles super

name: Katarzyna
text: A fantastic hotel located on the hills surrounding Nitra. The room was very spacious with a veranda, well equipped and elegant. Room service and the whole personel in general was trully outstanding. The breakfast had everything that we could wish for. The parking was free of charge and we got delicious gifts upon check-out. We travel around the world a lot and we can certainly say that the Golden Key hotel is on our top list so far.

name: Natalie
text: It had great design, very helpful staff and state of the art facilities. The quality of food and dining experience was superb. A lovely place to stay with a great wellness area.

name: Patrik
text: Pohodlné tvrdé matrace, atmosféra hotela, lokalita, izby, raňajky

name: Petronela
text: Krásny výhľad a úžasné zariadenie

name: David Hrdlička
text: Luxus, perfektní hotel, ví že host je nejdůležitější a umí se k němu chovat. Jak budu moct ,tak přijedu znova a znova a znova .

name: Debora
text: Beautiful, charming, clean, unique, tasteful!

name: Kristína
text: Ubytovanie v tomto hoteli splnilo všetky naše očakávania, príjemný personál krásne prostredie aj celková atmosféra hotela.

name: Peter H
text: Krásny luxusný hotel, skvelá kuchyňa, personál a obsluha.

name: Turnerova
text: Všetko, nádherné ubytovanie aj personál milý. Proste všetko sa mi tu páčilo. Aj ten výhľad na Nitru. Velmi rada sa sem vždy vrátim. Vrelo odporúčam.

name: Aleksandra
text: Widok z góry na miasto piękny. Hotel czysty i cudownie urządzony.

name: Mária
text: Veľmi pekný hotel, krásny interiér, super wellnes aj vonkajší bazén.

name: Trpák
text: Krásny zaujímavý hotel všade čisto a útulné,Krásny výhľad,čistý bazén a pekný welnes.Personal ústretový

name: Stanka
text: Skvělý hotel, výborné služby, milý personál. Pokoj prostorný s terasou, čistota bezchybá. Snídaně v krásném prostředí s výhledem na Nitru, nicméně nabídka byla spíše průměrná a doba vymezená na snídaně byla jen do 9.30 hod. Velmi příjemný venkovní bazén.

name: Júlia
text: Všetko perfektné, ako vždy.

name: Kevin
text: This hotel deserves 5-star status. The rooms, the views, the team.... these are all great assets to this wonderful hotel. Safe parking available within the hotel grounds.

name: Ursula
text: Tolle Aussicht von der Terrasse auf die Burg und die Hügel von Nitra. Großzügige Zimmer, voller Komfort, sauber. Gute internationale Küche.

name: Dirk
text: Sehr schönes Hotel, sehr gutes Frühstück, sehr schöne Zimmer mit Terrasse und Kaffeemaschine

name: Dmitrii
text: Wonderful panoramic view of the city. Enjoyed swimming pool (looks like only for certain residencies). Nice AC. Very nice spa, but maybe a bit too hot in the relax area. Massage was very nice and professional. The hotel has very polite and welcoming personnel!

name: Hubert
text: In jeder Hinsicht, zuvorkommende Mitarbeitende. Äusserst geschmackvoll eingerichtetes Haus. Sehr ansprechende Wellness-Oase. Top Aussicht über die Stadt. Ansprechende Wein- und Speisekarte. Kontinentales Frühstücksbuffet.

name: Filip
text: Krásná poloha nad městem, nádherné wellness i pokoje. Snídaně byly výborné a bohaté.

name: William
text: la chambre correspond à un quatre étoiles , le restaurant est trés bien ,mais cher pour les presstations offertes , petit déjeuné correspond au cadre général , copieux , varié parfait , hôtel dont il faut impérativement se rappeler de l'adresse afin de pouvoir y revenir

name: Julius
text: Hotel ma nádherný wellnes a naozaj veľmi príjemné gastro.

name: Henrieta
text: Everything. Restaurant, beautiful views, our room and specially the swimming pool. Nice and helpful staff too

name: Yehezkel
text: The staff is incredibly welcoming and makes the hotel stay very pleasant. The bed is extremely comfortable. The hotel is located in an unconventional location. The spa is truly special.

name: Petr
text: Výborná lokalita, super výhledy z teras, čistý a příjemný bazén. Přátelské prostředí, ochotný a komunikující personál. Snídaně velmi dobré, stejně tak i nabídka jídel a nápojů v restauraci. Postele pohodlné a všeobecná čistota. Rádi se vrátíme.

name: Nina Hricová
text: Príjemný personál, tichá poloha.

name: Sajni
text: Beautiful decor and smell, excellent facilities and food in restaurant, very helpful staff

name: Karin
text: Extraordinary place, perfect location. Nice breakfast in an airy atmosphere.

name: Katarina
text: Veľmi pekný, príjemný a kvalitný hotel v Nitre.

name: Karolína
text: Prostredie v okolí hotela bolo nádherne a hotel celkovo pôsobil naozaj luxusne. Personál bol veľmi príjemný a ústretový. Wellness bol okúzľujúci a bolo tam všetko potrebné na oddych ako napríklad fínska sauna, parná sauna, bazén s masážnymi tryskami a aj oddychová zóna. Hotel má aj vonkajší bazén, ktorý je vyhrievaný. Raňajky tiež boli vynikajúce, množstvo jedál na výber a všetko bolo naozaj výborne. Veľmi milé bolo aj privítanie na recepcii s prossecom a pri odchode nám darovali vynikajúce makrónky.

name: Tomáš Haramach
text: Její minus tohoto hotelu je tvrdší matrace, ale personál to dokázal okamžitě vyřešit, což oceňuji.

name: Martin Stolár
text: Prijemne miesto, prijemna a pozorna obsluha a pekny vyhlad z terasy.

name: Zuzana
text: Páčilo sa nám všetko :) krásny čistý a voňavý hotel so skvelou kuchyňou

name: Dávid Kurhajec
text: Nádherné miesto, dokonalé výhľady na celú Nitru. Vynikajúci, šikovný a milí personál, veľmi chutné jedlo...12/10...dokonalé.😊

name: Agnieszka
text: Pobyt minął przyjemnie, pokoje czyste, jedzenie smaczne. Hotel położony w pięknym miejscu z codownym widokiem. Chętnie wrócimy

name: Dušan Hanzel
text: Boli sme ako svadobný hostia Odporúčam na podobné akcie je to na jednotku

name: Elena Plačková
text: Víkendový pobyt v hoteli Zlatý kľúčik bol pre nás s manželom nezabudnuteľný. Úžasný personál, služby na najvyššej úrovni, čistota, nádherné prostredie, maximálny komfort, bol to pre nás skutočný relax. Odporúčam každému zažiť raj na zemi = Zlatý kľúčik.

name: Romano Romaker
text: Vynikajúce miesto pre svadbu, všetko profesionálne zvládnuté od A po Z . Všetky požiadavky zvládnuté na 1*, odchádzali sme nad ránom a mimoriadne spokojní. Treba sa pripraviť, že voľný termín je viac než o pár mesiacov .

name: Petr Hora
text: Great hotel with a beautiful view of the city. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room was clean and comfortable, and the breakfast was very good with many choices. Only the ventilation in the toilet was broken and the wellness area is open only until 10 p.m. Otherwise, everything was perfect.

name: Дмитрий
text: Everything was good. The staff is very polite and helpful, the breakfast was good, and the view from the hall and the suit is awesome. This is a great place to stay for a night. The spa is great also, but could be too warm to stay for long in the main space.

name: Majula Majulka
text: V Zlatom klúčiku sme boli prvý krát. Prostredie úžasné. Krásne výhlady. Izby čisté, voňavé. Kuchyňa - no proste gastronomický zážitok. Zvlášť chcem vyzdvihnúť personál. Ten si zaslúži 5 hviezdičiek. Obrovskí profesionáli. Obsluha, recepcia, wellnes ... Ďakujem za skvelý zážitok z celého pobytu. ❤️⚘️⚘️⚘️ Vikartovský+Filová

name: martin mališ
text: lepsie ako som cakal, urcite hotel ktory raz treba navstivit

name: Herbert Heinrich
text: Wunderschönes Hotel mit Wellness toll gelegen mit tollem und freundlichen Personal. Klasse Essen haben uns rundherum wohl gefühlt und kommen bestimmt wieder.

name: Markus Krammer
text: Wirklich tolles Hotel mit freundlichem Personal, super leckerem Essen und großzügigem Spa-Bereich 👍

name: Radovan Rydzi
text: Hotel s nezabudnuteľnou atmosférou, profesionálnym servisom a dokonalým výhľadom na mesto Nitra. 👍

name: Daniel Toth
text: Nádherný hotelik, s krásnym výhľadom, suprový personal ktorý sa vždy usmieval. Sme radi že sme sa rozhodli stráviť víkend práve tu. Wellness krásny, izba útulná a čistá, na raňajkách nám nič nechýbalo a bolo si z čoho vyberať, všetko bolo vždy chutné a čerstvé.

name: Andreas Menne
text: sehr schön gelegenes Hotel. Auf der Terasse einenen herlichen Blick auf Nitra. incl. Sonnenuntergang.TOP. Exelentes Essen mit sehr aufmerksamer Bedienung. Schöne saubere Zimmer mit genialem Matratzen. wir kommen wieder

name: Dušan Hudák
text: Kuchyna je neskutocna. Chodim tam hlavne kvoli jedlu. Vecera vykompenzuje, ak sa nahodou najdu, vsetky nedostatky hotela. Urcite pridem znova…

name: Silvia Deak
text: Einen wunderschönen Ort , das Hotel Super Extra schön und gemütlich , das Personal stets bemüht , die Rezeption Damen sind sehr professionell , sprechen perfekt englisch und geben dir das kleinste Detail für alles , was das Hotel angeht. Ich bin sehr oft beruflich dort , meistens 4 Tage der Woche und falls an einen Freitag nicht viele Gäste gibt , ich wurde wie eine Prinzessin zum Frühstück behandelt . DANKE EUCH , GOLDEN KEY TEAM ❤️❤️ Freue mich auf nächste Woche bei euch zu sein 🦋💐

name: Anna
text: Food, service, climate, comfort

name: Réka Svébis
text: Loved it, great hospitality

name: Inéz Haláková
text: Úžasný zážitok, od príjemného a profesionálneho personálu, cez krásny hotel s nádherným výhľadom, wellnesom, pohodlnými posteľami, až po fantastické jedlo aj vínko. Ďakujeme, určite sa vrátime.

name: Réka
text: View from the dining room

name: Cvitan
text: the soa area was very beuatiful and relaxing, the breakfast was splendid as well

name: Anna Fiťková
text: Krásný hotel so super službami a príjemným personálom.

name: Valentin
text: Restaurant with gastronomic food and very nice and friendly staff.

name: Kristína Golianová
text: Nádherný hotel s krásnym výhľadom a úžasným wellnessom. Personál bol mimoriadne ochotný, milý a vždy usmiaty. Celý hotel bol dokonale čistý a všetko v ňom príjemne voňalo, čo vytváralo výnimočnú atmosféru. Večera bola skutočným kulinárskym zážitkom – výborné chute, krásne naservírované jedlá a vysoká kvalita surovín. Na úroveň služieb sú ceny viac než priaznivé. Skvelý pobyt, určite sa radi vrátime.

name: Peter Haburaj
text: Super hotel pekný výhľad 👍

name: Renata Laurová
text: Vynikajúci hotel, príjemný personál,welnes, akurát chýba masáž

name: Theodoros Prineas
text: Excellent location with great view and comfortable stylish rooms. Great mattress!

name: Rene
text: The breakfast was good, but it ended too early on Sunday. In other hotels it is available until 12 p.m., but since the breakfast area also appears to be used as the restaurant, extending the time might not be possible. The room was quiet, comfortable, and spacious enough. Parking was conveniently located close to the rooms.

name: Nikola Magnusová
text: Nadherny hotel, super wellness, ranajky este lepsie. Krasne okolie, mily personal. Perfektne okienko na toaletny papier🤣😇

name: Alina
text: Nice spa and a great view from the window. The welcome drink was a pleasant bonus. There is also parking near the hotel.

name: Radoslav
text: Beautiful luxurious place

name: Bray
text: Amazing location Well laid out, peaceful, tranquil. Staff was excellent and food was delicious! Wouldn’t stay anywhere else!

name: Eytan
text: Location, comfort, well designed, great restaurant

name: Fee_J_80
text: This was my second stay at the hotel while travelling with work. I absolutely love everything about this hotel. The rooms, the food, the staff are exceptional. I would never stay anywhere else. As I travel alone I didn't feel like going for dinner on my own so ordered room service, the food was superb! Next time I will have to give the spa a whirl. THANKYOU for such a wonderful stay
text_sk: Toto bol môj druhý pobyt v hoteli počas pracovných ciest. Na tomto hoteli absolútne milujem všetko. Izby, jedlo aj personál sú výnimočné. Nikdy by som sa neubytovala nikde inde. Keďže cestujem sama, nechcelo sa mi ísť na večeru samej, tak som si objednala izbovú službu – jedlo bolo vynikajúce! Nabudúce musím vyskúšať aj spa. ĎAKUJEM za nádherný pobyt.

name: Tommy
text: Very clean and chic, staff are friendly...it's by far the nicest hotel in Nitra.

name: Van
text: Great location, fantastic views over the city. Great kitchen. Thank you.

name: Tommy
text: The place is extremely clean with great attention to detail. I love the decor; very classy and subtle. All the staff are great and super accommodating.

name: Martynkova
text: Comfortable bed and oriental spa

name: Evans
text: Rooms were lovely. Food and breakfast were next level. Spa and outdoor pool brilliant.

name: Silvia
text: Excellent stay in a beautiful mountain-top setting! The whole experience was outstanding - from super comfy beds and perfect rooms to the beautiful pool and sunbathing area! The breakfast spread was so well prepared and had a lot to choose from. We also used the SPA, which was very clean, well-maintained and relaxing. Throughout our stay the team was super friendly and helpful, we really felt well taken care of!

name: Mazvita
text: Lovely hotel in a wonderful location. All staff were friendly and always greeted us with a smile. The rooms were clean, breakfast was great (great variety of hot and cold options) and I really enjoyed our little terrace with our room. Will definitely be coming back here again.

name: Brittany
text: EVERYTHING! The interior was so stunning and all the amenities and the breakfast was excellent too! Should definitely be a 5 star hotel instead of 4! ❤️

name: Max
text: Everything, honestly it was Fantastic, from the staff, the dinner was really superb with a good range of wine. The bed was really good and comfortable.

name: Emily
text: The view was stunning and the staff were so friendly. The only downside is that it is far from the centre of town, but the hotel itself has everything you need.

name: TheFifthBeatle
text: We did not know what to expect but we were positively surprised. Very polite and friendly stuff and spacious rooms. So comfortable beds! The breakfast and dinners were delicious and waiters very helpful, they described all dishes with details. Moreover, food was served quickly and was so tasty and fresh. Also, the breakfast menu was very good, we loved the pastries ❤️ The stay was rich with extras like spa, which was amazing. We are so relaxed now!
text_sk: Nevedeli sme, čo očakávať, ale boli sme pozitívne prekvapení. Veľmi zdvorilý a priateľský personál a priestranné izby. Aké pohodlné postele! Raňajky a večere boli vynikajúce a čašníci veľmi ochotní, všetky jedlá nám podrobne opísali. Jedlo bolo navyše servírované rýchlo, chutné a čerstvé. Raňajkové menu bolo veľmi dobré, zamilovali sme si pečivo ❤️ Pobyt bol bohatý na extra služby ako spa, ktoré bolo úžasné. Sme teraz takí oddýchnutí!

name: Skyler
text: Very nice location, very clean hotel and very nice staff

name: Lily
text: Very beautiful location. The room was big and I had a terrace with little green area only for us. I was draveling with a big dog and we did find little green area at the lowest level of the buildings. The room looked super beautiful. Nice breakfast. There are parking spaces everywhere and I got to park just in front of our entrance. Everything was very clean.

name: Tatiana
text: Beautiful location with wonderful view, the staff was very accomodating, the room was spacious, clean and very comfortable. Plus the spa was amazing. We will definitely come back

name: Marcel
text: It has been out fourth time here and we will definitely come back

name: Jana
text: One of the most beautiful hotels in Slovakia. It was great stay with delicious food, perfect service and amazing breakfast. Room was very nice, modern, and the biggest bonus was terrace with view on Nitra castle, city and even calvary. Wellness is limited for 2 hours with limited amount of people (we were almost alone) and totally new. Highly recommended.

name: Katerina
text: We stayed at this hotel for one night, and it was a truly wonderful and relaxing experience. The hotel is stunning, with everything in excellent condition, and the rooms are exceptionally comfortable. I also loved the L'Occitane cosmetics. And the mattresses! They are absolutely perfect. The breakfast is delicious, and the staff goes above and beyond to ensure guests feel welcome.

name: Czech
text: The hotel is immaculate and beautiful. We loved the Christmas decorations. Both rooms had nice furnishings, comfortable beds and were clean. The breakfast was delicious, plenty of choice and the view from the dining room was georgeous.

name: Růžička
text: Luxury hotel with perfect service.

name: Kresz
text: Real luxury experience, beautiful hotel, excellent SPA, delicious breakfast

name: Rebecca
text: Cozy and modern Classic style circa 2010s. Very well kept with nice amenities like the spa.

name: Petra
text: The hotel was amazing, luxurious, well decorated, with very nice ambiance. Amazing views of the whole city. The room was also perfect, we loved the little terrace/garden with a view where you could drink coffee in the morning. Hotel staff was helpful and very pleasant. The food in the hotel restaurant was among the top I tried in Slovakia. The SPA was also very pleasant and the massage was very relaxing. Overall great experience!

name: Katarzyna
text: Beautiful place wth amazing view. Very comfortable stay in wonderful room with everything what is needed - free welcome drink, amazing room and very good breakfast. Smell inside very sensitive but hard to forget - all detials on the highest level.

name: Lana
text: Beautifully designed hotel , amazing spa , delicious breakfast

name: Veronika
text: Beautiful location with great view ovwrlooking the city, great staff

name: Chris
text: Friendly staff, quick & professional check in, free parking on site, high quality rooms. Luxury spa included in the price

name: Danielius
text: One of best SPA's ever seen, with some facilities found only found in top top level establishments. Room, view, breakfast, all was really good. Also perfect place to have hike up to the mountain towards Zabor pyramyd / Zabor via ferraras climbings.

name: Von
text: Design, luxury Friendly professional staff Exceptional food

name: Bellido
text: Bread in breakfast is very good

name: Alexandra
text: Loved the whole hotel, the enteriors, the lovely breakfast, the amazing dinner with live piano. Super comfortable room and amazing service.

name: Bence
text: A luxury hotel situated on the hilltop, spanning multiple levels. The decor is very sophisticated, and the rooms are adorned with plenty of sparkle, perhaps a bit more than necessary. It is exceptionally clean and spacious, with comfortable beds. The terrace rooms with plants create a very cozy atmosphere. The view of the city from the height is splendid, especially during sunset, which is worth experiencing. The dinner was delicious, while the breakfast was more on the average side.

name: Bruce
text: Stayed here for three nights at the end of August, celebrating in-laws birthdays and wedding anniversary. Lovely hotel, clean in all common areas and spacious well-appointed rooms, with excellent food for lunch and dinner in the hotel restaurant, served by attentive staff. The wellness centre is fantastic. You can book use of the wellness centre in 2-hr blocks, so plenty of time to relax and enjoy all the different facilities.
text_sk: Skvelý hotel v Nitre s rovnako skvelým a ochotným personálom. Koncom augusta sme tu strávili tri noci, oslavovali sme narodeniny a výročie svadby svokrovcov. Krásny hotel, čistý vo všetkých spoločných priestoroch, priestranné a dobre vybavené izby, s výborným jedlom na obed aj večeru v hotelovej reštaurácii a pozorným personálom. Wellness centrum je fantastické. Vstup sa dá rezervovať v 2-hodinových blokoch, takže je dosť času na oddych a všetky procedúry.

name: Sylvia V
text: A wonderful hotel in a beautiful environment, with very nice staff, excellent massages, and a very pleasant environment. We cannot imagine a better place for autumn relaxation. We will definitely be happy to come back.
text_sk: Nádherný hotel v krásnom prostredí, s veľmi milým personálom, vynikajúcimi masážami a veľmi príjemnou atmosférou. Lepšie miesto na jesenný relax si nevieme predstaviť. Určite sa radi vrátime.

name: Alexandra
text: Hotel is located on a hill where the view is just brilliant. Staff was very welcoming and the room was spacious and clean. Same was the wellness center - nice and quiet, just for us. Definitely worth booking
text_sk: Hotel sa nachádza na kopci, odkiaľ je jednoducho úžasný výhľad. Personál bol veľmi milý a izba priestranná a čistá. Rovnako aj wellness centrum – pekné a tiché, len pre nás. Určite stojí za rezerváciu.
